# Categorical Rollup: Agent Skill Evals & Benchmarks

> Comprehensive categorical family index for AI agent skill evaluation, calibration, and benchmarking.

## Family Members

- [Skill Evals Core Pack](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/skill-evals/llms.txt): Base architecture, trigger calibration, and execution benchmarking.
- [Full Text](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/skill-evals/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive deep-dive documentation and patterns.
- [Compact Study Reference](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/skill-evals/llms-small.txt): Fast in-context rules and thresholds.
- [Atomic Facts](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/skill-evals/llms-facts.txt): Sourced propositions and standards.
- [Vocabulary & Lexicon](file:///Users/mitch/dev/evals/packs/skill-evals/llms-vocabulary.txt): Concept relationships and technical terms.

## Evaluation Tooling & Repositories

- [Evals Harness & Templates](https://github.com/mithudso/evals): Public repository containing test runners, templates, and benchmark reports.
- [Deep Eval Optimizer](file:///Users/mitch/dev/skills/deep-eval-optimizer/SKILL.md): 12-pass convergence loop skill for auditing and generating eval suites.
- [Skill Optimizer](file:///Users/mitch/dev/skills/skill-optimizer/SKILL.md): Skill production quality gate with automatic missing-eval generation.
